name: EOD 2026-06-11
body:
> Eod · Alphalete · 2026-06-11

Thursday. Alphalete blog production: 10 SEO posts written, optimized and staged as WordPress drafts.

# Alphalete Trenchless
See [Alphalete Trenchless (Hub)](lib:brain-alphalete-trenchless-hub).
- Batch 1 (Trenchless/CIPP education): pillar "What Is Trenchless Sewer Repair and How Does It Work?" plus 4 supporting posts.
- Batch 2: 5 supporting posts completing the Sewer Problems and Hydro Jetting clusters. About 9,900 words total.
- Each post has a "Quick answer" lead, FAQ section and hub-and-spoke internal links. No dollar figures or invented specs; cost, duration and pipe-bursting items flagged for Scott.
- Cannibalization-checked all 10 keywords against the 237 programmatic local pages.
- Compiled [SEO Blog Writing Standards](lib:brain-seo-blog-writing-standards) and applied the exact-keyphrase-in-title rule (4 mismatches fixed). All 10 script-verified; 8 metas trimmed to 155 characters.
- Loaded as unpublished drafts (post IDs 12681 to 12684 and 12686 to 12691) with Yoast fields set. Published count unchanged at 6.
- Found 4 older scott-vincent drafts, 2 overlapping the gurgling/sewer-smells post.
- Content plan: 16 of 30 topics done (6 published, 10 draft).

# Follow-ups
- Kim reviews and publishes the 10 drafts (pillar 12681 first).
- Scott to confirm cost framing (12682), project duration (12686), and whether Alphalete offers pipe bursting (12683).
- Decide on the 4 older drafts.
- GSC: confirm re-submitted sitemap shows Success, request indexing on new URLs after publish. See [GSC Indexing Tracker](lib:brain-gsc-indexing-tracker).
